description:
Enhanced Vehicle Store Continued

The great vehicle store by Smokeystatue, with new features and fixes.

Enhanced Vehicle Store by Smokeystatue is one of the best interface mods for Transport Fever 3. It replaces the Buy window of a depot with one sortable table of every vehicle, it shows the numbers that really decide which vehicle is better, and its train builder tells you how your train performs before you pay. All of that is the work of Smokeystatue, and this mod would not exist without it. Thank you!

The original has had no update for a while, so this mod continues it. It holds everything of version 1.3, plus the changes below.

How to install

  • Deactivate the original Enhanced Vehicle Store first. Both mods replace the same store window, so only one of them can be active.
  • Then activate Enhanced Vehicle Store Continued.
  • Only the interface changes. Nothing is added to your save, so you can switch at any time.

New in the vehicle table

  • Grades for noise, pollution and comfort. Three thin columns show a letter from A to E, green for good and red for poor, on the game's own rating. Hover a letter for the exact value. Click the icon in the header to sort.
  • Specialization bubbles. A specialized wagon shows the game's coloured bubble before its name and in its details, so you see which wagon fits which terminal.
  • Length instead of Weight. Power and tractive effort left the table to make room, because Pull and Accel. already tell what they decide. Weight, power and tractive effort are still in the details.
  • Time to top speed for multiple units. The 0-top column shows on the Multiple units tab too.
  • Bars that start at zero. A bar is the value as a share of the best one, so half a bar means half the value.

New filters

  • Range filters. The Filters button opens a panel with a From and a To slider for every column. Show only vehicles from 1990 on, below a price, or above a speed. Each depot remembers its limits while the game runs.
  • The cargo filter means "and". Tick coal and iron ore, and you get the vehicles that carry both.
  • Any cargo and All cargo. Two buttons instead of one: Any cargo lists every vehicle that carries cargo, All cargo lists the vehicles that carry every cargo type.

New in the window and the train

  • The window grows with your screen. It takes 88 % of the screen height. On a 16:9 screen it takes the room from the line manager to nearly the right edge. On an ultrawide screen it takes three quarters of the width.
  • Modify All Vehicles. Modify of several trains at once opens the Enhanced Store too, when the trains have the same cars. One train stands for all of them, and every train keeps its own cars with their age and value.
  • Details from the train. Click a vehicle of your train to open its details. Click it again to close them.

Fixed

  • The specialization of a wagon was not shown anywhere in the store.
  • Modify of several trains at once fell back to the game's store.
  • A train without a locomotive can no longer be bought or modified: the button is off, as in the game's own store. In the original such a train stopped the game with a fatal error, which should no longer happen.

Good to know

  • Works next to Vehicle Power & Slope Stats: the store and the panel of that mod fill the window together. On a 16:9 screen the window then starts over the right part of the line manager, so the table keeps its width next to that panel.
  • Modify of trains with different cars still opens the game's store.
  • The mod keeps its own settings, so it starts with the default settings once.
  • English only, like the original.

Thanks

If you find this mod useful, please rate the original Enhanced Vehicle Store too. Smokeystatue did the hard part.
name: Enhanced Vehicle Store Continued
summary: Enhanced Vehicle Store, continued: grades, range filters, bigger window, Modify for many trains.
